item.title: Minami Aso Museum & Volcano Science — Guide
item.description: In Minami-Aso (‘southern Aso’), on the floor of the great caldera, this museum introduces the geology, volcanoes, nature and water of the Aso region through accessible exhibits. Aso’s landscape is the product of colossal ancient eruptions and ongoing volcanic activity, and the museum helps visitors understand how the vast caldera formed, how the still-active Nakadake volcano behaves, and how the region’s ecosystems and famous pure spring water are shaped by this volcanic land.
